<Subject 1> is the adult Japanese underworld assassin positioned in the left section of the room. He wears dark clothing and holds one clearly visible katana. The same katana remains in his hands throughout the complete attack. It must not disappear, duplicate, transform, bend, change size, or switch hands without a physically continuous movement.

<Subject 3> is the Black young man in the right foreground. He wears large dark over-ear headphones, a brown knit cardigan, a white T-shirt, light blue jeans, and white retro sneakers. He stands naturally behind the folding table and continues folding clothes without noticing the attack.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] At 0.00 seconds, begin below the laundry-room floor in the same clean, featureless black transition area established by <Video 1>. Continue the exact upward trajectory, centered framing, and speed curve from the Blender reference. Do not reveal another room, corridor, exterior environment, sky, or unrelated architecture.

As the camera crosses the floor and enters the laundry room, reveal the exact environment and composition from <Picture 1>. The central dark-gray equipment island remains the dominant central obstruction. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> occupy the left section of the composition, while <Subject 3> remains in the right foreground behind the folding table.

At the beginning of the visible laundry-room section, the entire environment is completely clean. There is absolutely no blood on the floor, walls, laundry equipment, central island, table, linens, clothing, katana, assassin, or victim. Do not generate blood before physical contact occurs.

Before <Subject 1> attacks, <Subject 2> visibly turns toward him. The victim’s head turns first, followed by the neck, shoulders, chest, waist, and hips. The rotation must be physically continuous and clearly readable. The victim must not remain facing away during the entire attack. The assassin keeps the katana controlled and does not begin the first strike until the victim’s turning movement is visibly established.

Once the turn is visible, <Subject 1> immediately performs exactly three consecutive katana strikes.

The first strike is a fast, committed katana swing with a clear attack line, full blade travel, body-weight transfer, and visible follow-through.

Without returning to a neutral pose, the first strike flows directly into the second strike. The second strike follows a different readable attack line and is completed with clear blade movement, torso rotation, foot pressure, and follow-through.

The assassin then immediately performs the third strike. The third strike is distinct from the first two and must be fully completed. Do not combine the three strikes into one vague movement. Do not skip a strike, hide every strike, replace the sequence with random sword waving, or allow the assassin to freeze between attacks.

Blood may appear only after the first katana strike makes physical contact. It must not exist before the attack. Keep all blood restrained and non-graphic, with no close-up wounds, exposed organs, dismemberment, or excessive gore.

Only after the third strike has been completed, <Subject 2> loses balance and falls fully to the floor. His body reacts to the direction and force of the third strike. The fall has believable weight, momentum, and loss of balance. He does not remain standing, reset his pose, or rise again.

As soon as <Subject 2> is fully on the floor, <Subject 1> immediately performs one additional finishing strike. There is no pause, hesitation, slow motion, prolonged preparation, or theatrical pose.

For the finishing strike, the assassin raises the katana briefly above shoulder height and immediately drives it downward in one fast, decisive, powerful continuous arc. The motion begins through the shoulders, continues through the torso and hips, and transfers into the front foot. The blade travels clearly downward and completes the strike with strong follow-through and a short physical recoil. The finishing strike must feel sudden, heavy, forceful, and final. It must not look soft, floating, weak, delayed, or incomplete. The assassin must not stop with the katana raised; the blade must complete the entire downward motion before the camera leaves the room.

Throughout the complete action, <Subject 3> remains in the right foreground, looking down at the clothes while listening through his headphones. He continues folding naturally and never turns toward the left side. He does not look up, stop moving, remove the headphones, react to the victim’s fall, or notice the finishing strike.

Preserve <Subject 3> as one anatomically coherent adult figure. His head, torso, pelvis, thighs, knees, lower legs, ankles, and shoes remain naturally connected. Both feet stay planted on the floor with believable weight distribution. The foreground table remains a separate object and its legs must not merge with his body or legs.

The camera continuously follows <Video 1> and never stops for the attack. After the third strike, fall, and completed finishing strike, the camera continues rising through the ceiling and roof with the same upward momentum. The final 0.5 seconds extend into a clean, featureless black upper transition area. Do not generate another room, hallway, roof interior, pipes, exterior building, sky, or unrelated environment above the laundry room.

Realistic hotel laundry-room ambience: low ventilation noise, distant mechanical hum, subtle fabric movement, footsteps, four distinct katana swings, three separate initial impact sounds, the weighted sound of the victim falling, and one sharp, forceful finishing-strike impact. Every sound must correspond to a visible physical action. No dialogue, no narration, no exaggerated screaming, and no stylized horror sound effects.
